title: Northgate Tire Center Care Standard — Rotation Uplift on Treadwear Credits
content:
# Rotation care uplift on treadwear credits

**Standard.** A Northgate Tire Center treadwear credit is uplifted for a set that was rotated regularly. The uplift is read from the **average rotation interval**: the miles driven from the package's installation odometer to the odometer on the claim entry (the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package), divided by one more than the count of rotation entries recorded on the package, whatever their dates — a rotation entry dated after the claim entry counts too.

| Average rotation interval | Rotation uplift |
|---|---|
| at most the package's recommended rotation interval (5000 miles on every Northgate Tire Center package) | 1.1 |
| above 5000 miles and at most 7000 miles | 1.05 |
| above 7000 miles | 1 — no uplift |

**How the uplift acts.** The prorated treadwear amount — the price per tire multiplied by the treadwear remaining mileage share — is multiplied by the rotation uplift. The uplift acts on the unrounded amount, and the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

| Miles driven | Rotation entries | Average interval | Uplift |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30000 | 5 | 30000 divided by 6, that is 5000 | 1.1 |
| 30000 | 4 | 30000 divided by 5, that is 6000 | 1.05 |
| 35000 | 4 | 35000 divided by 5, that is 7000 | 1.05 |
| 30000 | 3 | 30000 divided by 4, that is 7500 | 1 |
| 21000 | 0 | 21000 divided by 1, that is 21000 | 1 |

A prorated treadwear amount of $40.00 with an uplift of 1.05 becomes $42.00.
